transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

I feel like I’ve been tapped for something huge at work and in town, like I’m the only one who really understands what’s going on and everyone else just needs to catch up to me. My wife and my boss pressured me to come in, but honestly, I'm just operating on a completely different level of understanding right now.
Have you felt this way before, or is this the first time you've experienced such a strong sense of increased energy, confidence, or racing thoughts?

No, this definitely isn't the first time. These revved-up, high-energy phases where my thoughts race and I feel incredibly confident have been cycling on and off for well over a year and a half now, starting a few months after I took on a major IT migration project. Honestly, these "up" periods have taken up the vast majority of my time over the last two years.
When you're in these 'up' periods, do your symptoms last for at least four consecutive days with increased energy, less need for sleep, and possibly impulsive or risky behavior?

Yes, they definitely last much longer than four days, often stretching on for weeks at a time. During these phases, I only sleep two or three hours a night but feel completely supercharged, constantly pacing and starting all kinds of new projects. I also get really irritable and impatient if anyone tries to slow me down or questions what I'm doing.

The chronic and cycling nature of symptoms over more than a year and a half supports this diagnosis. No new information contradicts this, and there is sufficient evidence to maintain F31 as the sole candidate.
